Net.NoGM: No GM is connected: persistent animation changes cannot be saved.

MinTriggerRole.Name: Minimum role to trigger animations
MinTriggerRole.Hint: Users below this role cannot play or broadcast animations (automation and macros). Gamemasters are always allowed.

EffectsDisabled.Name: Disable animations on this client
EffectsDisabled.Hint: Do not render any Sargas Visual Automation effect on this computer. Other players are not affected.

ReducedMotion.Name: Reduced motion
ReducedMotion.Hint: Skip non-essential motion: screen-wide effects, return trips and scale-in/out animations. Persistent effects are kept.

Volume.Name: Animation sound volume
Volume.Hint: Volume multiplier for sounds played by animation sequences on this computer.
